ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. It is released when the game loses focus.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause gameplay when the game window is inactive. Sound remains muted while inactive.
plugin.name: Deer Avenger 4 Fusion Fix
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the fix menu language. Auto uses English. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restores the settings on this plugin page.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply these settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then confirm to apply it.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup logos and intro movie. Other movies remain available. Restart the game to apply.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a fixed window, or monitor-sized borderless. Requires an adapter with native windowed support. Restart the game to apply.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original fits the whole movie inside the original 4:3 frame. Fill fits it to the screen. Both keep the entire picture at its original proportions.
FOVFactor.description: Multiply the normal gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing. Aiming, scripted shots and the hub keep their own framing. Applies immediately.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Limit gameplay HUD to this aspect ratio. Automatic uses the full width. Changes apply immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Checks once for a newer fix when enabled. Off makes no network request. The notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after exit when available.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game. Press Accept or Back to dismiss.
update.availablesite: {name} {version} is available. Get the update at fusionfix.io. Press Accept or Back to dismiss.
